**Rules.** Copy every file verbatim: do not restyle, rename classes, reformat, "improve", convert to another styling approach (CSS modules, styled-components, inline styles) or add npm packages. React and Tailwind CSS v4 only. Keep `'use client'` lines where they are. If a file already exists with identical contents, leave it. ## Specification

### Component: InlineEdit

Text that becomes an input without moving. Same font metrics, padding compensated by a negative margin; Enter or blur saves, Esc cancels, validation and pending states built in.

#### Anatomy
```
<span class="ui-inline-edit" data-state="view|edit" [data-pending] [data-invalid] [data-disabled]>
  <span class="ui-inline-edit-sizer" aria-hidden>text (invisible, sets the cell width)</span>
  <button class="ui-inline-edit-display">text | <span class="ui-inline-edit-placeholder"></span></button>     view
  <input class="ui-inline-edit-input" type="text">                                                           edit
  <span class="ui-inline-edit-affix" aria-hidden>pencil | spinner | check</span>
  <span class="ui-inline-edit-error" role="alert">message</span>
  <span class="ui-inline-edit-live" role="status">Saved</span>
</span>
```

#### Props
- `value` / `defaultValue` / `onValueChange` (fires on successful save).
- `onSave?: (next: string) => unknown | Promise<unknown>` — a returned promise shows pending; a thrown `Error` keeps the field open with its message (fallback "Couldn’t save. Try again.").
- `validate?: (next: string) => string | null | undefined` — blocks saving with a message; runs before `onSave`.
- `label` (default "Value", the accessible name), `placeholder` ("Add a value"), `allowEmpty` (false), `emptyMessage` ("Can’t be empty"), `saveOnBlur` (true), `selectOnEdit` (true), `maxLength`, `disabled`, `onEditingChange`, `inputClassName`.

#### Visual rules
- Sizer, button and input share **one grid cell** (`grid-area: 1/1`), `box-sizing: border-box`, `font: inherit`, `letter-spacing: inherit`, `line-height: inherit`, padding `2px 8px` (`--ui-ie-py`, `--ui-ie-px`) and a 1px border.
- The root's negative margin is `-(padding + 1px)` on every side, so the text sits exactly where plain text would. The swap changes colour and border, never position.
- Display: transparent; hover (fine pointer) `--ui-accent` fill + `--ui-border`. Input: `--ui-background`, `--ui-border-strong`, `0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent)`. Invalid: `--ui-destructive` border and 30% ring. Pending: opacity .7, `cursor: progress`.
- Affix sits outside the text (`left: 100%`), pencil only on hover / `:focus-visible`. Error: 12px, `--ui-destructive-text`, absolutely positioned 4px below (never shifts layout). Radius `--radius-sm`.

#### Behaviour
- Click or Enter / Space on the text starts editing: input focused, all text selected.
- Enter saves; Esc cancels and restores (stops propagation); blur saves (or cancels when `saveOnBlur={false}`). Enter is ignored during IME composition. Unchanged text exits without calling `onSave`. Empty → `emptyMessage` unless `allowEmpty`.
- Pending: input read-only, `aria-busy`, spinner in the affix; Esc and blur are ignored until it settles.
- After a keyboard save or cancel, focus returns to the text; after a blur it does not.
- Success flashes a check for 1.4s and announces "Saved".

#### Motion
- Display ↔ input: background, border and shadow transition 150ms `--ui-duration-fast` `--ui-ease-standard`. No position or size animation (the point of the component).
- Pencil hint fades 150ms. Check: `ui-pop-in` 220ms then `ui-fade-out` 300ms after 1.1s. Error: `ui-rise-in` 220ms.
- **Reduced motion**: error appears with a 1ms fade; check has no pop; colours still change.

#### Accessibility
- View: real `<button>` named "Edit {label}: {value}". Edit: text input with `aria-label={label}`, `aria-invalid`, `aria-describedby` → the error, `aria-busy` while pending. Errors use `role="alert"`.

#### Acceptance checks
- Bounding box of the text (view) and of the input's text (edit) differ by ≤ 1px; the font-size and line-height computed values are identical.
- Enter saves and shows the new value; Esc restores; blur saves.
- `validate` returning a message keeps the input open with `aria-invalid="true"`.
- A rejecting `onSave` keeps it open with the message; a resolving one closes it with a check.

## Files

Paths are relative to the folder the `@/` alias points to. The folder keeps the library's own layout, so the relative imports inside the files work unchanged.

### `ui/components/inline-edit/inline-edit.tsx`

```tsx
'use client';

import { forwardRef, useEffect, useId, useRef, useState, type ChangeEvent, type HTMLAttributes, type KeyboardEvent } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../../lib/cn';
import { CheckGlyph, SpinnerGlyph } from '../../lib/glyphs';
import { useControllableState } from '../../hooks/use-controllable-state';
import { Icon } from '../../icons/icon';

export interface InlineEditProps extends Omit<HTMLAttributes<HTMLSpanElement>, 'defaultValue' | 'onChange' | 'onSubmit'> {
  /** Controlled value. */
  value?: string;
  /** Initial value when uncontrolled. */
  defaultValue?: string;
  /** Called with the new value once it is saved. */
  onValueChange?: (value: string) => void;
  /**
   * Persist the new value. Return a promise to show a pending state; throw (or
   * reject) with an Error to keep the field open and show its message.
   */
  onSave?: (next: string) => unknown | Promise<unknown>;
  /** Return an error message to block saving. Runs before `onSave`. */
  validate?: (next: string) => string | null | undefined;
  /** Accessible name of the field, e.g. "Project name". */
  label?: string;
  /** Shown when the value is empty. */
  placeholder?: string;
  /** Allow saving an empty value. Default false. */
  allowEmpty?: boolean;
  /** Message when empty is not allowed. Default "Can’t be empty". */
  emptyMessage?: string;
  /** Blur saves (true, default) or cancels (false). */
  saveOnBlur?: boolean;
  /** Select all text when editing starts. Default true. */
  selectOnEdit?: boolean;
  maxLength?: number;
  disabled?: boolean;
  /** Called when editing starts or ends. */
  onEditingChange?: (editing: boolean) => void;
  /** Class for the input while editing. */
  inputClassName?: string;
}

/**
 * InlineEdit — text that becomes an input without moving. The input shares the
 * text's font metrics, and its padding and border are cancelled by a negative
 * margin, so the words stay where they were. Enter or blur saves, Esc cancels.
 */
export const InlineEdit = forwardRef<HTMLSpanElement, InlineEditProps>(function InlineEdit(
  {
    value: valueProp,
    defaultValue = '',
    onValueChange,
    onSave,
    validate,
    label = 'Value',
    placeholder = 'Add a value',
    allowEmpty = false,
    emptyMessage = 'Can’t be empty',
    saveOnBlur = true,
    selectOnEdit = true,
    maxLength,
    disabled,
    onEditingChange,
    inputClassName,
    className,
    ...props
  },
  ref,
) {
  const [value, setValue] = useControllableState<string>({ value: valueProp, defaultValue, onChange: onValueChange });
  const [editing, setEditing] = useState(false);
  const [draft, setDraft] = useState(value);
  const [error, setError] = useState<string | null>(null);
  const [pending, setPending] = useState(false);
  const [saved, setSaved] = useState(false);
  const inputRef = useRef<HTMLInputElement | null>(null);
  const displayRef = useRef<HTMLButtonElement | null>(null);
  const finished = useRef(false);
  const pendingRef = useRef(false);
  const refocus = useRef(false);
  const mounted = useRef(true);
  const savedTimer = useRef(0);
  const onEditingChangeRef = useRef(onEditingChange);
  onEditingChangeRef.current = onEditingChange;
  const errorId = useId();

  useEffect(() => {
    mounted.current = true;
    return () => {
      mounted.current = false;
      window.clearTimeout(savedTimer.current);
    };
  }, []);

  useEffect(() => {
    onEditingChangeRef.current?.(editing);
    if (editing) {
      const input = inputRef.current;
      if (!input) return;
      input.focus();
      if (selectOnEdit) input.select();
    } else if (refocus.current) {
      refocus.current = false;
      displayRef.current?.focus();
    }
  }, [editing, selectOnEdit]);

  const begin = () => {
    if (disabled) return;
    setDraft(value);
    setError(null);
    finished.current = false;
    setEditing(true);
  };

  const finish = (restoreFocus: boolean) => {
    finished.current = true;
    refocus.current = restoreFocus;
    setError(null);
    setEditing(false);
  };

  const flashSaved = () => {
    setSaved(true);
    window.clearTimeout(savedTimer.current);
    savedTimer.current = window.setTimeout(() => setSaved(false), 1400);
  };

  const commit = async (fromBlur: boolean) => {
    if (finished.current || pendingRef.current) return;
    const next = draft.trim();
    if (next === value) {
      finish(!fromBlur);
      return;
    }
    const problem = !next && !allowEmpty ? emptyMessage : validate?.(next);
    if (problem) {
      setError(problem);
      if (!fromBlur) inputRef.current?.focus();
      return;
    }
    if (!onSave) {
      setValue(next);
      flashSaved();
      finish(!fromBlur);
      return;
    }
    pendingRef.current = true;
    setPending(true);
    setError(null);
    try {
      await onSave(next);
      if (!mounted.current) return;
      setValue(next);
      flashSaved();
      finish(!fromBlur);
    } catch (err) {
      if (!mounted.current) return;
      setError(err instanceof Error && err.message ? err.message : 'Couldn’t save. Try again.');
      if (!fromBlur) inputRef.current?.focus();
    } finally {
      pendingRef.current = false;
      if (mounted.current) setPending(false);
    }
  };

  const cancel = (restoreFocus: boolean) => {
    if (pendingRef.current) return;
    finish(restoreFocus);
  };

  const handleKeyDown = (e: KeyboardEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
    if (e.key === 'Enter' && !e.nativeEvent.isComposing) {
      e.preventDefault();
      void commit(false);
    } else if (e.key === 'Escape') {
      e.preventDefault();
      e.stopPropagation();
      cancel(true);
    }
  };

  const handleBlur = () => {
    if (finished.current || pendingRef.current) return;
    if (saveOnBlur) void commit(true);
    else cancel(false);
  };

  const shown = (editing ? draft : value) || placeholder;

  return (
    <span
      {...props}
      ref={ref}
      className={cn('ui-inline-edit', className)}
      data-state={editing ? 'edit' : 'view'}
      data-pending={pending || undefined}
      data-invalid={error ? '' : undefined}
      data-disabled={disabled ? '' : undefined}
    >
      <span className="ui-inline-edit-sizer" aria-hidden="true">
        {shown}
        {'​'}
      </span>
      {editing ? (
        <input
          ref={inputRef}
          type="text"
          className={cn('ui-inline-edit-input', inputClassName)}
          value={draft}
          placeholder={placeholder}
          maxLength={maxLength}
          readOnly={pending}
          spellCheck={false}
          autoComplete="off"
          aria-label={label}
          aria-invalid={error ? true : undefined}
          aria-describedby={error ? errorId : undefined}
          aria-busy={pending || undefined}
          onChange={(e: ChangeEvent<HTMLInputElement>) => {
            setDraft(e.target.value);
            if (error) setError(null);
          }}
          onKeyDown={handleKeyDown}
          onBlur={handleBlur}
        />
      ) : (
        <button
          ref={displayRef}
          type="button"
          className="ui-inline-edit-display"
          disabled={disabled}
          aria-label={`Edit ${label.toLowerCase()}: ${value || 'empty'}`}
          onClick={begin}
        >
          {value || <span className="ui-inline-edit-placeholder">{placeholder}</span>}
        </button>
      )}
      <span className="ui-inline-edit-affix" aria-hidden="true">
        {pending ? (
          <SpinnerGlyph />
        ) : saved && !editing ? (
          <CheckGlyph className="ui-inline-edit-ok" width={14} height={14} />
        ) : (
          !editing && <Icon name="pencil" size={14} className="ui-inline-edit-hint" />
        )}
      </span>
      {error && (
        <span id={errorId} role="alert" className="ui-inline-edit-error">
          {error}
        </span>
      )}
      <span className="ui-inline-edit-live" role="status" aria-live="polite">
        {saved ? 'Saved' : null}
      </span>
    </span>
  );
});
```

### `ui/hooks/use-controllable-state.ts`

```ts
'use client';

import { useCallback, useRef, useState } from 'react';

/**
 * State that can be controlled (`value` + `onChange`) or uncontrolled
 * (`defaultValue`). Every stateful component uses this so the two modes
 * behave identically.
 */
export function useControllableState<T>({
  value,
  defaultValue,
  onChange,
}: {
  value?: T;
  defaultValue: T;
  onChange?: (value: T) => void;
}): [T, (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => void] {
  const [internal, setInternal] = useState<T>(defaultValue);
  const controlled = value !== undefined;
  const current = controlled ? (value as T) : internal;
  const currentRef = useRef(current);
  currentRef.current = current;
  const onChangeRef = useRef(onChange);
  onChangeRef.current = onChange;

  const setValue = useCallback(
    (next: T | ((prev: T) => T)) => {
      const resolved = typeof next === 'function' ? (next as (prev: T) => T)(currentRef.current) : next;
      if (Object.is(resolved, currentRef.current)) return;
      currentRef.current = resolved;
      if (!controlled) setInternal(resolved);
      onChangeRef.current?.(resolved);
    },
    [controlled],
  );

  return [current, setValue];
}
```

### `ui/icons/icon.tsx`

```tsx
import { forwardRef, type SVGProps } from 'react';
import { cn } from '../lib/cn';
import { iconPaths, type IconName } from './paths';

export interface IconProps extends Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'> {
  /** Icon shape. */
  name: IconName;
  /** Pixel size (width and height). Default 16. */
  size?: number | string;
  /** Stroke width. Default 1.75. */
  strokeWidth?: number;
  /** Accessible label. Without it the icon is decorative (aria-hidden). */
  label?: string;
}

/**
 * Built-in stroke icon. Inherits `currentColor`.
 *   <Icon name="check" />   <Icon name="search" size={20} label="Search" />
 * Server Component–safe.
 */
export const Icon = forwardRef<SVGSVGElement, IconProps>(function Icon(
  { name, size = 16, strokeWidth = 1.75, label, className, ...props },
  ref,
) {
  return (
    <svg
      ref={ref}
      xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg"
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={size}
      height={size}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={strokeWidth}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden={label ? undefined : true}
      aria-label={label}
      role={label ? 'img' : undefined}
      focusable="false"
      className={cn('ui-icon', className)}
      // Static, library-owned SVG markup — never user input.
      dangerouslySetInnerHTML={{ __html: iconPaths[name] }}
      {...props}
    />
  );
});

export { iconPaths, type IconName };
```

### `ui/lib/cn.ts`

```ts
/**
 * Join class names, skipping falsy values.
 * No tailwind-merge needed: ui-* classes live in Tailwind's `components`
 * layer, so any utility passed in `className` already wins.
 */
export type ClassValue = string | number | false | null | undefined;

export function cn(...classes: ClassValue[]): string {
  let out = '';
  for (const c of classes) {
    if (!c) continue;
    out = out ? `${out} ${c}` : String(c);
  }
  return out;
}
```

### `ui/lib/glyphs.tsx`

```tsx
import type { SVGProps } from 'react';

type GlyphProps = Omit<SVGProps<SVGSVGElement>, 'ref'>;

/**
 * Small motion glyphs shared by the morphing buttons. Styles live in
 * styles/components/action-button.css (`ui-glyph-*`).
 */

/** A 14px ring spinner. Inherits currentColor. */
export function SpinnerGlyph({ className }: { className?: string }) {
  return <span aria-hidden="true" className={className ? `ui-glyph-spinner ${className}` : 'ui-glyph-spinner'} />;
}

/** A check that draws itself (stroke-dashoffset). */
export function CheckGlyph(props: GlyphProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={16}
      height={16}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2.25}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
      {...props}
      className={props.className ? `ui-glyph-check ${props.className}` : 'ui-glyph-check'}
    >
      <path d="M5 12.5l4.5 4.5L19 7.5" pathLength={1} />
    </svg>
  );
}

/** A cross that pops in. */
export function CrossGlyph(props: GlyphProps) {
  return (
    <svg
      viewBox="0 0 24 24"
      width={16}
      height={16}
      fill="none"
      stroke="currentColor"
      strokeWidth={2.25}
      strokeLinecap="round"
      strokeLinejoin="round"
      aria-hidden="true"
      focusable="false"
      {...props}
      className={props.className ? `ui-glyph-cross ${props.className}` : 'ui-glyph-cross'}
    >
      <path d="M6 6l12 12M18 6L6 18" />
    </svg>
  );
}
```

### `ui/styles/components/inline-edit.css`

```css
/* Inline edit ---------------------------------------------------------------
   <span class="ui-inline-edit" data-state="view|edit" [data-pending] [data-invalid]>
     <span class="ui-inline-edit-sizer">text</span>        invisible; gives the cell the text's width
     <button class="ui-inline-edit-display">text</button>  or  <input class="ui-inline-edit-input">
     <span class="ui-inline-edit-affix">pencil | spinner | check</span>
     <span class="ui-inline-edit-error" role="alert">…</span>
   </span>
   Sizer, button and input share one grid cell, one font and one padding + 1px border.
   A negative margin of (padding + border) puts the text exactly where plain text would be,
   so the swap changes colour and border — never position.
   ------------------------------------------------------------------------ */

@layer components {
  .ui-inline-edit {
    --ui-ie-px: 0.5rem;
    --ui-ie-py: 0.125rem;
    position: relative;
    display: inline-grid;
    max-width: calc(100% + 2 * (var(--ui-ie-px) + 1px));
    margin-inline: calc(-1 * (var(--ui-ie-px) + 1px));
    margin-block: calc(-1 * (var(--ui-ie-py) + 1px));
    vertical-align: baseline;
    font: inherit;
    letter-spacing: inherit;
    line-height: inherit;
  }

  .ui-inline-edit-sizer,
  .ui-inline-edit-display,
  .ui-inline-edit-input {
    grid-area: 1 / 1;
    box-sizing: border-box;
    min-width: 3ch;
    margin: 0;
    padding: var(--ui-ie-py) var(--ui-ie-px);
    border: 1px solid transparent;
    border-radius: var(--radius-sm);
    font: inherit;
    letter-spacing: inherit;
    line-height: inherit;
    text-align: start;
  }
  .ui-inline-edit-sizer {
    visibility: hidden;
    overflow: hidden;
    white-space: pre;
    pointer-events: none;
  }

  .ui-inline-edit-display,
  .ui-inline-edit-input {
    width: 100%;
    height: 100%;
    align-self: stretch;
    color: inherit;
    outline: none;
    transition:
      background-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      border-color var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard),
      box-shadow var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }

  .ui-inline-edit-display {
    overflow: hidden;
    background: transparent;
    white-space: pre;
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
    cursor: text;
    appearance: none;
    -webkit-appearance: none;
    -webkit-tap-highlight-color: transparent;
  }
  .ui-inline-edit-display:disabled { cursor: default; }
  .ui-inline-edit-placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-inline-edit-display:hover:not(:disabled) {
      background-color: var(--ui-accent);
      border-color: var(--ui-border);
    }
  }
  .ui-inline-edit-display:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent); }

  .ui-inline-edit-input {
    background-color: var(--ui-background);
    border-color: var(--ui-border-strong);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-ring) 45%, transparent);
    text-overflow: ellipsis;
  }
  .ui-inline-edit-input::placeholder { color: var(--ui-muted-foreground); opacity: 1; }
  .ui-inline-edit[data-invalid] .ui-inline-edit-input {
    border-color: var(--ui-destructive);
    box-shadow: 0 0 0 3px color-mix(in oklch, var(--ui-destructive) 30%, transparent);
  }
  .ui-inline-edit[data-pending] .ui-inline-edit-input { opacity: 0.7; cursor: progress; }

  /* Pencil hint / spinner / saved check: beside the text, never in the flow */
  .ui-inline-edit-affix {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-start: 100%;
    top: 50%;
    display: inline-flex;
    translate: 0 -50%;
    margin-inline-start: 0.125rem;
    color: var(--ui-muted-foreground);
    pointer-events: none;
  }
  .ui-inline-edit-hint {
    opacity: 0;
    transition: opacity var(--ui-duration-fast) var(--ui-ease-standard);
  }
  @media (hover: hover) and (pointer: fine) {
    .ui-inline-edit[data-state="view"]:hover .ui-inline-edit-hint { opacity: 1; }
  }
  .ui-inline-edit[data-state="view"]:has(:focus-visible) .ui-inline-edit-hint { opacity: 1; }
  .ui-inline-edit-ok {
    color: var(--ui-success-text);
    animation: ui-pop-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both, ui-fade-out 300ms var(--ui-ease-in) 1100ms forwards;
  }

  .ui-inline-edit-error {
    position: absolute;
    inset-inline-start: 0;
    top: calc(100% + 0.25rem);
    z-index: 1;
    padding-inline: var(--ui-ie-px);
    color: var(--ui-destructive-text);
    font-size: var(--text-xs);
    line-height: 1rem;
    font-weight: 400;
    letter-spacing: normal;
    white-space: nowrap;
    animation: ui-rise-in var(--ui-duration) var(--ui-ease-out) both;
  }

  .ui-inline-edit-live {
    position: absolute;
    width: 1px;
    height: 1px;
    margin: -1px;
    padding: 0;
    overflow: hidden;
    clip-path: inset(50%);
    white-space: nowrap;
    border: 0;
  }
}

/* Reduced motion: borders and fills still change; no rise, no pop */
@media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) {
  .ui-inline-edit-error { animation: ui-fade-in 1ms both; }
  .ui-inline-edit-ok { animation: ui-fade-out 300ms linear 1100ms forwards; }
}
```

## Usage

**Rename a project** — from the docs (`apps/docs/examples/inline-edit/rename-project.tsx`), imports rewritten to `@/ui/...`:

```tsx
'use client';

import { InlineEdit } from '@/ui/components/inline-edit';

const wait = (ms: number) => new Promise((resolve) => setTimeout(resolve, ms));

export default function InlineEditRenameProject() {
  return (
    <div className="w-full max-w-md">
      <h3 className="text-2xl font-semibold tracking-tight">
        <InlineEdit
          defaultValue="Q4 launch plan"
          label="Project name"
          maxLength={40}
          validate={(name) => (name.length < 3 ? 'Use at least 3 characters' : null)}
          onSave={async (name) => {
            await wait(700);
            if (name.toLowerCase() === 'untitled') throw new Error('That name is reserved');
          }}
        />
      </h3>
      <p className="mt-3 text-sm text-muted-foreground">Click the name, type, then press Enter. Esc cancels.</p>
    </div>
  );
}
```
